summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of HRIS & Payroll SaaS Phase 1 + Employee Core module. Backend: 92.9% pass rate (65/70 tests). Frontend: Login, navigation, employee management, reminders, and documents pages all functional. All UI text correctly in Bahasa Indonesia. Tenant isolation verified working. Minor RBAC seeding issue found (manager role missing contract:view permission in database).

medium_bugs.issue: Manager role missing 'contract:view' permission in database despite being defined in rbac.py
medium_bugs.impact: Manager role cannot view contracts (GET /contracts returns 403)
medium_bugs.reproduction: Login as manager@nep.co.id, try GET /api/contracts -> 403. RBAC definition in rbac.py line 147 includes 'contract:view' but database role_permissions table doesn't have it for manager role.
medium_bugs.suggested_fix: Update seeder to be idempotent for permission updates, or add migration to top-up missing permissions for existing roles

minor_issues.issue: Returns 404 for seeded documents without actual file attachments
minor_issues.impact: Expected behavior - seeded documents don't have storage_path
minor_issues.note: This is expected for demo data. Real uploaded documents work fine.
